title: Purple Pill feat. HRSSN - Just A Little (Sunrise Vocal Mix)

lines.l: I can't walk, down this road anymore
Too long, I've been searching for
So shine your light on me
Guide me to where we both belong
The world's so cold for me
I can barely recognize you anymore
Give me time, just a little
Show me love, just a little
Keep it up, just a little
I need more, just a little
